description: Offline retrieval baseline enforced by CI (ikg eval --check). Every key under metrics must not get worse; item counts must not shrink. Since 2026-10-23 expectations are section- or verse-level and only primary text (verse, narrative) counts as a hit; before, they were book-level and gave hit@1 0.625 / hit@k 0.958. Update it in the same PR as any change that legitimately moves these numbers, and say why in the PR.
previous: BM25 alone, 2026-10-23: hit@1 0.282, hit@k 0.62, MRR 0.423. Hybrid (BM25 + bge-small-en-v1.5 dense, reciprocal rank fusion) beat it on hit@k and MRR and became the default (docs/08 A3, docs/06 §1). CI builds with --embed and reuses cached vectors.
